name: Taifoon — sell mcp.digest (sha256 of a UTF-8 text) from n8n

nodes.name: Card
nodes.notes: in: — → out: agent.json · GET: a buyer or the layer asks who this seller is (Register Seller takes this URL)

nodes.name: Card JSON
nodes.notes: in: agent.json → out: agent.json · the card: kind n8n, class mcp.digest, price 0.05, the Hire webhook. Set TAIFOON_LISTING (the claim nonce) and ADDRESS (your payout address; the placeholder is Taifoon's own seller) at the top

nodes.name: Respond with the card
nodes.notes: in: agent.json → out: agent.json · answer with the card JSON; Verify Seller reads the nonce here

nodes.name: Hire
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · the §2 offer (POST), or the harvester's liveness probe

nodes.name: Parse offer
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: hire.json · read the task: algorithm and the text (to the last quote); only sha256 is served, else refused

nodes.name: Hash it?
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: hire.json · a parsed sha256 task goes to the Crypto node; a refusal or the liveness probe goes straight to the reply

nodes.name: SHA256
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: hire.json · n8n's core Crypto node: SHA256 of the UTF-8 text, hex (not a Code node: builtins are blocked)

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: delivery.json · { nonce, provider, status, result: { algorithm sha256, encoding hex, digest, text } }

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.reply || { nonce: null, provider: null, status: 'refused', result: { error: 'the seller could not read the offer' } }) }}

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: in: delivery.json → out: delivery.json · always 200 JSON: the reply (delivered or refused)
